messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The Claims Tasks panel disappeared unexpectedly, forcing the team to undergo mid-week retraining due to a lack of advance notice for interface changes.
  quote: last week the Claims Tasks panel vanished without warning, and we had to retrain our team mid-week. We’d really appreciate advance notice and grouped updates.
- problem: Unexpected UI changes cause staff confusion and operational delays due to lack of prior notice.
  quote: We had unannounced screen changes last time and it caused confusion and delays because staff had to relearn where everything was — we really need advance notice and previews going forward.
- problem: The customer wants advance notice and a preview of interface changes to avoid unnecessary retraining efforts.
  quote: we just need a bit of warning and maybe a preview before changes go live, so we don’t waste time retraining.
- problem: Unexpected changes to the user interface require frequent staff retraining, leading to lost time and reduced accuracy.
  quote: It’s the unexpected interface changes — we keep having to retrain staff because buttons and menus shift without warning, and that’s costing us time and accuracy.
- problem: Unexpected interface changes are causing processing errors and requiring mid-cycle staff retraining.
  quote: The unexpected interface changes have forced us to retrain staff mid-cycle, which is causing errors in our claims and payments processing — we really need advance notice and bundled releases next time.
- problem: The Claims Tasks panel disappeared unexpectedly, forcing the team to undergo mid-week retraining due to a lack of advance notice for interface changes.
  quote: last week the Claims Tasks panel vanished without warning, and we had to retrain our team mid-week. We’d really appreciate advance notice and grouped updates.
- problem: Recent interface changes in the platform are disrupting the team's workflow efficiency.
  quote: we’ve been meaning to talk about how your platform’s recent interface tweaks are throwing off our team’s rhythm.
- problem: Unexpected interface changes moved key controls without warning, causing staff errors and requiring retraining.
  quote: we had to retrain three people just to find the new location, and someone even submitted a payment in error because the button moved. We’ve had to retrain staff because unexpected interface changes moved key controls without warning — it’s causing real errors in claims and payments.
